room_rent.note: Base room rent at actuals up to SI; optional Modifier 9.1 can REDUCE to Single Private AC / Twin Sharing for premium discount

icu.note: ICU/ICCU at actuals up to SI

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay; optional Voluntary Co-Payment (10.2) for premium discount

sub_limits.note: Main IPD/room/ICU at actuals up to SI; optional room-rent reduction modifier

deductible.note: Optional Voluntary Deductible (10.1) available for premium discount

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting 24 months (12.1); changeable via optional Modifier 9.3

specific_disease_waiting.note: Reducible to 12 months via optional Modifier 9.2

maternity.note: Maternity & Child Care (3.3) is an optional cover; 24-month waiting; waives Excl 18 when opted; not inbuilt in base

cumulative_bonus.note: VERIFY %: Cumulative Bonus (11.1) per claim-free year as specified in Policy Schedule; alternatively opt premium discount (11.2)

restoration.note: Restore Benefit (3.1(h), Essential Cover) restores base SI unlimited times for subsequent related & unrelated claims; not available if optional Unlimited/Endless SI opted

pre_hosp.note: VERIFY: Pre-hospitalization for period specified in Policy Schedule; days not stated in wording

post_hosp.note: VERIFY: Post-hospitalization for period specified in Policy Schedule; days not stated in wording

ambulance.note: VERIFY: Road Ambulance (3.1(a)) up to limit specified in Policy Schedule; amount not stated in wording

consumables.note: Medicines, drugs and consumables listed under In-Patient Treatment cover

global_cover.note: Plan Ahead / Planned Hospitalization abroad is an optional cover (3.2(j)); 24-month waiting

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity & global (Plan Ahead) are optional covers; standard IRDAI exclusions (Excl01-18)

optional_riders.display: Maternity & Child Care, Plan Ahead (overseas), Endless/Unlimited Sum Insured, Convalescence, Voluntary Deductible/Co-pay, Room-rent reduction, PED/specific-waiting reduction modifiers
